message: The other night, we had a surprise blackout just as I was settling in with a book. Instead of panicking, I grabbed my trusty flashlight and some snacks, and turned the living room into a cozy little hideaway. We pulled out the power bank to keep our phones charged, and before we knew it, we were sharing stories and giggles by flashlight. It was a sweet reminder that even unexpected moments can be turned into special memories. Have you ever turned a blackout into a cozy event? I'd love to hear your stories! 😊
